units.source_text: 傍晚时分，匂亲王来到二女公子室中。

en.t: Toward evening, Prince Niou came to the Second Princess's rooms.

units.source_text: 二女公子正在里面洗发，众侍女各在自己房中休息，室中空无一人。

en.t: The Second Princess was inside washing her hair, and the ladies-in-waiting were all resting in their own rooms, so the chamber was completely empty.

units.source_text: 匂亲王呼一小女童来，叫她去对二女公子说：“我回家时你偏偏洗发，叫人太难堪了。

en.t: Prince Niou called over a little girl and sent her to tell the Second Princess, "Just when I am going home, you choose to wash your hair; it puts me in such an awkward position.

units.source_text: 难道让我一人寂寞无聊么？”

en.t: Are you really going to leave me alone, lonely and bored?"

units.source_text: 二女公子叫侍女大辅君出来对他说道：“一向都是趁大人不在家时洗的。

en.t: The Second Princess sent her attendant Daisuke no Kimi out to say to him, "We have always washed it when Your Highness was away from home.

units.source_text: 可是近来夫人异常疲劳，久不洗了。

en.t: But lately my lady has been unusually tired and has gone a long time without washing it.

units.source_text: 过了今天，本月内别无吉日。

en.t: After today, there is no other auspicious day this month.

units.source_text: 而九月、十月都是不宜洗发的，所以只得今天洗。”

en.t: And since both the ninth and tenth months are unsuitable for washing hair, she had no choice but to wash it today."

units.source_text: 她表示抱歉。

en.t: She conveyed her apologies.

units.source_text: 此时小公子正在睡觉，故侍女们都在那边。

en.t: At that time the young lord was asleep, so all the attendants were over there with him.

units.source_text: 匂亲王百无聊赖，且向各处闲步。

en.t: Prince Niou, with nothing at all to occupy him, wandered idly here and there.

units.source_text: 他看见西边的屋子那面有一个面孔陌生的女童，猜想这屋子里住着新来的侍女，便走近去窥探。

en.t: Seeing an unfamiliar young girl near the room on the west side, he guessed that a newly arrived attendant must be staying there, and went closer to peer inside.

units.source_text: 他从中间的纸隔扇的隙缝里张望一下，但见里面离开纸隔扇一尺左右的地方立着屏风，屏风一端沿着帘子设置着帷屏。

en.t: He looked through a crack in the middle paper sliding door and saw that about a foot inside it stood a folding screen, with a curtain screen set along the blinds at one end.

units.source_text: 帷屏上的一条垂布揭起着，那里露出女子的袖口，里面衬的是紫菀色的华丽衣服，外面罩的是女郎花色衫子。

en.t: One hanging cloth on the curtain screen had been lifted, revealing a woman's sleeve: beneath was a splendid robe of aster purple, and over it a jacket the color of maiden flowers.

units.source_text: 有一个屏风折叠着，从这里窥探，里面的人并不觉得。

en.t: A folding screen stood partly folded, and from this spot he could look in without the person inside noticing.

units.source_text: 他想：“这新来的侍女想必是很漂亮的吧。”

en.t: He thought, "This new attendant must be very beautiful."

units.source_text: 便小心地拉开通向厢房的纸隔扇，悄悄地步入廊内，竟无一人得知。

en.t: He carefully slid open the paper door leading to the side room and quietly stepped into the corridor, without anyone noticing at all.

units.source_text: 这里廊外的庭院里开着各种秋花，灿烂如锦。

en.t: In the garden outside this corridor, all kinds of autumn flowers were blooming, brilliant as brocade.

units.source_text: 池塘一带的假石也饶有趣致。

en.t: The arranged stones around the pond also had considerable charm.

units.source_text: 浮舟此时正躺在窗前欣赏此景。

en.t: Ukifune was at that moment lying by the window, enjoying the view.

units.source_text: 匂亲王把本来开着的纸隔扇再拉开些，从屏风的一端窥探。

en.t: Prince Niou opened the already ajar paper door a little farther and peered from one end of the screen.

units.source_text: 浮舟想不到是匂亲王，以为是常到这里来的侍女，便坐起身来，那姿态非常美妙。

en.t: Ukifune never imagined it was Prince Niou; thinking it was one of the attendants who often came there, she sat up, and her posture was extraordinarily lovely.

units.source_text: 匂亲王原是好色之徒，此时岂肯放过，便拉住了浮舟的衣裾，又把刚才拉开的纸隔扇拉上，自己在纸隔扇和屏风之间坐下了。

en.t: Prince Niou was by nature a man of amorous pursuits and would hardly let this chance pass; he caught hold of Ukifune's robe hem, shut the paper door he had just opened, and seated himself between the door and the screen.

units.source_text: 浮舟觉得奇怪，连忙以扇障面而向这边回顾，姿态又很美妙。

en.t: Ukifune found this strange and quickly shielded her face with her fan as she looked back this way, and again her bearing was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 匂亲王便握住她拿扇子的手，说道：“你是谁？

en.t: Prince Niou then grasped the hand that held her fan and said, "Who are you?

units.source_text: 把名字告诉我！”

en.t: Tell me your name!"

units.source_text: 浮舟害怕得很。

en.t: Ukifune was terribly frightened.

units.source_text: 匂亲王把脸朝着屏风，不让她看见，行动非常诡秘。

en.t: Prince Niou turned his face toward the screen so she could not see him, behaving in a very furtive manner.

units.source_text: 因此浮舟猜量他是最近热心找寻她的薰大将；闻到一股香气，更确信是薰大将，便觉非常羞耻，不知如何是好。

en.t: Because of this, Ukifune guessed that he was Captain Kaoru, who had lately been eagerly searching for her; catching a fragrance, she became even more certain it was Kaoru, and felt so ashamed that she did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 乳母听见里面情况异常，觉得奇怪，就推开那边的屏风，走进来看，说道：“这是怎么一回事？

en.t: The nurse heard that something unusual was happening inside and, finding it strange, pushed open the screen on that side, came in to look, and said, "What is going on here?

units.source_text: 真奇怪！”

en.t: How very strange!"

units.source_text: 但匂亲王如同不闻，毫无顾忌。

en.t: But Prince Niou acted as if he had not heard her and showed no restraint at all.

units.source_text: 这虽是无聊之极的恶戏，但因此人本性能说会道，所以这样那样地谈个不住，不觉天色已经全黑。

en.t: Although this was an utterly pointless and malicious prank, he was naturally glib, and as he kept talking on about one thing and another, the sky had, before they knew it, grown completely dark.

units.source_text: 匂亲王对浮舟说：“你是谁？

en.t: Prince Niou said to Ukifune, "Who are you?

units.source_text: 不把名字告诉我，我不放手。”

en.t: If you do not tell me your name, I will not let go."

units.source_text: 便从容自在地躺下身子。

en.t: Then he calmly and comfortably lay down.

units.source_text: 乳母这时候才知道是匂亲王，惊诧之极，一句话也说不出来。

en.t: Only then did the nurse realize that it was Prince Niou, and in her extreme astonishment she could not say a single word.
